# Ocean Tide Drop AI SURFER

> Practical AI implementation, AEO/GEO visibility, automation, and specialist AI agents for small and local businesses.

## Canonical customer journey

Discover → Diagnose → Plan → Implement → Transform

- Discover: Free AI Wave Check
- Diagnose: AEO Wave Audit and focused business diagnostics
- Plan: AI Opportunity Report, AEO Blueprint, Automation Blueprint, 30-Day Wave Plan
- Implement: specialist AI agents and business workflows
- Transform: Big Kahuna multi-area strategy and implementation

## Current public offers

- Wave Starter — $497 — one focused AI implementation sprint — direct purchase
- Wave Builder — $1,997 — connected visibility, lead flow, follow-up, or automation implementation — strategy call
- Tsunami Growth — $3,997 — multi-area AI strategy and deeper implementation — strategy call

If a visitor is unsure which offer fits, route them to the Free AI Wave Check.

## Specialist agent crew

- Wave Scout — opportunity discovery, visibility gaps, and lead intelligence
- Sales Rider — lead capture, response, follow-up, and conversion workflows
- Content Creator — repeatable AI-assisted content and campaign systems
- Customer Care Cove — customer support and service workflows
- Automation Architect — repetitive workflow design and integrations
- Big Kahuna — multi-area AI strategy and coordinated implementation

## AEO and GEO

AI SURFER evaluates practical AI-search readiness across:

- Conversational Intent
- Entity Authority
- Technical Readiness
- Content Authority
- AI Visibility
- Citation Opportunities

The goal is to make a business easier for people and AI systems to discover, understand, trust, summarize, and cite.
